title: Man Pulls Knife On LAPD Cops And Gets Shot
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Los Angeles, California — On August 22, 2025, at around 8:20 p.m., Los Angeles Police officers responded to a radio call of “ADW suspect there now,” at the 5400 block of Monterey Road. The comments of the call indicated that the suspect, later identified as 22-year-old Bryan Guzman, threatened the person reporting (PR) with a knife. When the officers arrived, the officers contacted the PR who directed them to the suspect Guzman, who was outside standing by a vehicle. The officers gave Guzman verbal commands to put his hands on top of his head. As the officers attempted to take Guzman into custody, he produced a knife resulting in an Officer Involved Shooting. Guzman was struck by the gunfire and fell to the ground, where he was taken into custody without further incident. Officers rendered aid until the arrival of Los Angeles Fire Department personnel. Guzman was transported to a local hospital and is in stable condition. A 12-inch kitchen knife was recovered at scene and booked as evidence. No officers or other community members were injured as a result of this incident.
